overview.headline: Heterozygosity and genetic diversity within populations

keyPoints.point: An individual with different alleles at a specific locus is heterozygous, while same alleles mean homozygous
keyPoints.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus

keyPoints.point: Allele frequency is used to characterize genetic diversity and richness of the gene pool in a population
keyPoints.quote: Allele frequency is used to characterize the genetic diversity, or richness of the gene pool, in a population.

keyPoints.point: Possible genotypes can be calculated using the stated formula from number of alleles at a particular locus
keyPoints.quote: can be calculated using the formula k(k+1)/2, where k is the number of alleles at a particular locus.

keyPoints.point: The observed heterozygosity compared to expected heterozygosity can reveal population dynamics
keyPoints.quote: The observed heterozygosity can be compared to the expected heterozygosity

keyTerms.gloss: having different alleles at a specific locus in a diploid cell
keyTerms.quote: If an individual has two different alleles at a specific locus, the individual is heterozygous at that locus

keyTerms.gloss: having same alleles at a locus inherited from each parent
keyTerms.quote: if the two alleles are the same, the individual is homozygous

keyTerms.gloss: frequency at which alleles are found at a locus of interest
keyTerms.quote: Allele frequency, or the frequency at which alleles are found at any locus of interest, is used to estimate the frequency of a given genetic profile.

keyTerms.gloss: unique set of alleles found by analyzing DNA from every member of a population
keyTerms.quote: A gene pool is the unique set of alleles that could be found by analyzing the DNA from every member of a species or population.

keyTerms.gloss: grid that graphically represents expected genotypes and frequencies
keyTerms.quote: A Punnett square is simply a grid that graphically represents expected genotypes.
